project.name: TurtleBot 4
project.subtitle: Semantic-risk-aware autonomous exploration
project.progressMethod: weighted technical checklist; schedule tasks never add overall progress twice
currentBlockers: The Stage 3 physical benchmark has not yet been run because the robot returned to the dock with low battery.
Rosbag and CSV outputs still need to be validated in one pilot run.
Success rate, travel time, path length, recoveries and failure metrics are still pending.

scope.excludedReason: Simulation is deferred outside the accelerated 10-week core scope. It may be restored only if the real-robot plan remains on schedule.

labPolicy.rule: Saturday is used only for a missed robot session, an unmet weekly completion gate, replacement experiment data or final demo recovery.

history.title: Project baseline created
history.detail: TurtleBot4 graduation project started with no verified robot workflow.

history.title: Robot connection and battery verified
history.detail: The laptop joined the TurtleBot4 ROS 2 network and BatteryState data was confirmed.

history.title: LiDAR, odometry and TF verified
history.detail: LiDAR operation, odometry and the required TF chain were confirmed.

history.title: First lab map saved
history.detail: SLAM produced a versioned occupancy map for later localisation.

history.title: Saved map and initial pose reproduced
history.detail: The map loaded successfully and AMCL initial pose was set in RViz.

history.title: Map-to-base TF verified
history.detail: The map → odom → base_link chain aligned scans with the saved map.

history.title: Multiple Nav2 goals completed
history.detail: Nav2 lifecycle nodes were activated and the real robot reached multiple operator-selected goals.

history.title: Stage 1 inputs completed
history.detail: RGB-D, timing and the 20-minute camera stability observation were verified with saved evidence.

history.title: Stage 2 navigation completed
history.detail: The new map, AMCL, Nav2, multiple goals, fresh-start verification and docking all succeeded on the real robot.

history.title: Stage 3 benchmark prepared
history.detail: Four fixed goals, baseline checksums and the benchmark runner passed dry-run; physical trials remain.

weeks.title: Stabilize Nav2 and the lab baseline
weeks.objective: Prove clean-start Localization/Nav2 and establish the fixed benchmark.
weeks.deliverable: Versioned map, repeatable startup, launch/config and 10-goal benchmark.

tasks.label: Document the verified baseline and standardise the repository.
Build cleanly; prepare checks, 10 fixed goals and the run sheet.
Cold-start the system; verify inputs/TF; run and record the 10 goals.
Validate/remap the map, run 20–30 minutes and commit launch/config.
Analyse goal success/failures and complete benchmark metrics.
Use only if the Week 1 completion gate is still unmet.
Write the Nav2 section and close Week 1 only after ≥8/10 goals.

weeks.title: Detect and cluster frontiers
weeks.objective: Detect reliable frontier clusters and centroids from OccupancyGrid.
weeks.deliverable: frontier_detector, RViz markers, logs and flowchart.

tasks.label: Define the frontier rule and output data model.
Implement frontier detection, clustering, filtering and markers.
Test live frontiers and capture wall/noise/unreachable errors.
Validate centroids, clearance and live frontier updates.
Analyse rosbag data and stabilise logs/parameters.
Use only if frontier markers or centroids remain unreliable.
Write frontier theory/flowchart and tag the weekly release.

weeks.title: Autonomous frontier navigation
weeks.objective: Execute frontier goals through Nav2 with automatic recovery.

tasks.label: Design the exploration state machine, nearest score and blacklist.
Implement NavigateToPose result handling and mock tests.
Validate single frontier goals before enabling the loop.
Run five consecutive goals and verify blacklist recovery.
Fix duplicate/stale goals and add goal-state timing logs.
Use until five autonomous frontier goals are achieved.
Write the baseline algorithm/state-machine section.

weeks.title: Complete the baseline and logger
weeks.objective: Run exploration end-to-end and collect repeatable metrics.
weeks.deliverable: Two valid full runs, CSV logger and official baseline config.

tasks.label: Define stop conditions and experiment metrics.
Implement CSV/run-ID logging, coverage, path length and reset.
Run the first complete exploration from a fixed start.
Complete two valid full runs and lock baseline configuration.
Plot coverage/path/frontiers and inspect missing fields.
Use if fewer than two valid full runs exist.
Document the baseline/logger and tag the release.

weeks.title: RGB-D object detection
weeks.objective: Detect three object classes and obtain reliable depth.
weeks.deliverable: Detection pipeline, three classes, threshold and evidence.

tasks.label: Select three portable classes and define detection metrics.
Implement RGB detection and robust median depth.
Verify RGB/depth frames, timestamps, range and viewing angles.
Test motion, occlusion and lock classes/threshold.
Analyse confidence/depth and improve filtering.
Use if camera stability or class selection is unresolved.
Write the RGB-D/object-detection section.

weeks.title: Object localisation and semantic map
weeks.objective: Transform detections to map frame, fuse duplicates and persist them.
weeks.deliverable: Semantic database, RViz markers, save/load and error results.

tasks.label: Define the semantic object record and fusion threshold.
Implement pixel-depth 3D transform, map TF, storage and markers.
Measure map-frame localisation error and debug TF/timestamps.
Build, save and reload a three-object semantic map.
Improve data association and calculate error/duplicate rate.
Use if TF, markers, duplicates or persistence remain unstable.
Write the semantic-mapping pipeline and tag the release.

weeks.title: Semantic-risk-aware frontier utility
weeks.objective: Run an explainable semantic/risk utility beside nearest-frontier.
weeks.deliverable: Two modes, YAML weights, score logs and one full proposed run.

tasks.label: Define and normalise information, distance, semantic and risk terms.
Implement both modes, YAML weights, history and score markers.
Compare baseline/proposed choices and run several goals.
Complete a full proposed run and tune only documented weights.
Analyse logs and lock pilot weights.
Use until one valid full proposed run exists.
Write the utility formula, rationale and flowchart.

weeks.title: Pilot experiment and configuration freeze
weeks.deliverable: Three pilot runs per method and experiment-v1.

tasks.label: Fix the environment, start pose, objects, timeout and validity rules.
Automate run folders and prepare interleaved run order.
Run three baseline pilots with exact resets.
Run three proposed pilots and validate utility logs.
Remove invalid runs, fill metrics and freeze code/config.
Use for failed pilots or freeze confirmation.
Write experiment design and tag experiment-v1.

weeks.title: Official experiments and analysis
weeks.objective: Collect comparative data and analyse results.
weeks.deliverable: At least ten valid runs, charts, media and results chapter.

tasks.label: Lock run order, reset checklist, storage and metadata form.
Replay logger and prepare objects, markers and recording.
Target three baseline and three proposed official runs.
Reach five valid runs per method and record final videos.
Clean data, calculate statistics and produce comparison charts.
Run only replacement trials for invalid or lost data.
Write the results chapter and tag final data.

weeks.title: Demo, thesis and release
weeks.objective: Prove reproducibility and finish all submission material.
weeks.deliverable: Final release, README, thesis, data, videos and slides.

tasks.label: Finish conclusions, limitations and charts; add no new features.
Write the cold-start README and final demo script.
Record the complete end-to-end mission from cold start.
Re-run from README and back up all code/config/maps/data/video.
Complete thesis structure, references and final conclusions.
Use lab only for a broken demo; otherwise finish slides.
Create final backup/release and rehearse demo/defence.
